item_title: Sources: Palo Alto Networks is buying Cider Security for up to $300M
item_description: Ingrid Lunden / TechCrunch: Sources: Palo Alto Networks is buying Cider Security for up to $300M — More consolidation is afoot in the world of cyber security.
